scope: Fresh native primes on warm basis/RHS inputs, including all physical and complete original seam checks; CPU=user+system. Excludes compilation/cold input generation/new QQ reconstruction. First prime includes structural learning and plan serialization; subsequent prime includes plan read and validation. Two-prime groups are learning+replay amortization, not same-prime repetitions.
rss_metric: Conservative maximum of 100ms sampled process RSS and kernel process high-water mark in phase logs; one process per native solve. Historical V17 reference uses its sampled minimum, which is conservative for the new gate.
scope_notes: Generic finite-field sparse/affine kernels, tested on arbitrary matrix families and two primes at both eight and nine loops. This does not establish universal speedups or global optimality. No ten-loop performance claim.
